name: Arcfin Sync
description: Keeps each user's Arcfin settings in step across their devices and keeps a record of those devices. Administrators set defaults and locks per setting, for everyone or for one user, from the Jellyfin dashboard. Also runs Pick Together sessions and watch parties, Seerr and TMDB through the server, signed security commands, watch-time limits, household features, notifications and Arcs (each off until an administrator turns it on), extracts single audio tracks for Arcfin downloads and reports which video encoders the server's hardware can use.
overview: Syncs Arcfin app settings across a user's devices, with admin defaults and locks.

versions.changelog: Arcs: short scenes from the server's films and episodes, picked for each person and played in a vertical feed in Arcfin on iPhone and iPad. Clips start at chapters, at cold opens, or at scene changes the Arcs scene index finds, skipping intros and credits, and are spoiler-safe by default. Recommendations learn from watch history, likes, watch time and favourites. Dialogue search, moods and reactions, best scenes for a title, friend codes for sending scenes to each other, request trailers through Seerr (which people or the administrator can turn off), personal stats and a clip of the day. Clips stream as HLS, made with Jellyfin's ffmpeg on the NVIDIA GPU (with HDR tone mapping) when Jellyfin uses NVENC, and on the CPU otherwise. The scene index decodes keyframes only, on the GPU too, with a setting for how many titles it scans at once. Off until an administrator turns it on, on the new Arcs tab.

Settings catalogue: Arcfin's music visualizer settings, Visualizer Style (Bars, Wave, Mirrored or Dots), Visualizer Placement (On the Cover or Bottom of the Player) and Visualizer Colour (From the Cover, Cover Colours, Spectrum or White Glass), which administrators can set defaults for and lock. They replace Colour from Cover.

Notifications: Arcfin tells people when their Seerr request is approved, declined or available, request managers about requests waiting for approval, approved automatically or failed, and reporters and issue managers about Seerr issues reported, commented on, resolved or reopened, plus announcements and planned maintenance. The server watches Seerr, within seconds with Seerr's webhook (its setup, a test check and the address to use are on the dashboard) and otherwise every ten minutes. Open Arcfin apps are told at once; others find the news when they next check. A test notification can be sent to one person. Seerr's issue calls now pass through the server. Off until an administrator turns it on.

Watch parties hosted from Arcfin over SyncPlay, joined by code or QR code and plannable up to 30 days ahead. Seerr and TMDB through the server: keys encrypted with AES-256-GCM and never sent to devices, Seerr calls made as the person using it, and a queue for requests made while Seerr is down. Signed commands with an automatically rotating P-256 key: clear a PIN, lock or unlock a profile, wipe a lost device, PIN rules, trusted devices, rules for devices that fall behind and for older Arcfin versions, and HTTPS away from home. Watch time and bedtime per person. Download limits for videos and music, shared accounts with Who's Watching, announcements and planned maintenance. Titles hidden from Continue Watching and Next Up, and recommendation rows for Home. Live control and history of watch parties and Pick Together sessions. Every feature is off until an administrator turns it on; Pick Together, hidden titles and signed commands stay on where they were already in use.

Pick Together: people on the server swipe through titles on iPhone and iPad until they agree on one, then watch it on one device, on another, or together over SyncPlay. They join with a code or a QR code in Arcfin; every call needs a sign-in. Each person only gets titles everyone in the session can see and, unless watched titles are included, that nobody has watched; a title is never dealt twice in a session. The device that starts a session hosts it: it deals new titles, removes people and locks the session, and several devices on one shared profile each take part. Administrators turn it on or off for everyone or for chosen users on a new Pick Together tab and from Arcfin.

Settings catalogue: the plugin carries Arcfin's list of settings and serves it at GET /ArcfinSync/Schema, and only settings in it are stored. GET/PUT /ArcfinSync/Sync: each value with where it comes from, which device changed the settings last, and Replace to send one device's settings to the user's others. A record of each user's Arcfin devices, which users and administrators can rename and forget. Server-wide and per-user defaults and locks for administrators. One configuration page with Overview, Settings and Users & Devices tabs. Removed the notification, Seerr webhook and advanced YAML options, which nothing used. GET/PUT Settings keep their shapes, and 0.3 locks and defaults stay written so going back to 0.3.1 keeps them.

Added GET /ArcfinSync/Items/{itemId}/Audio/{streamIndex}: copies one audio track out with the server's ffmpeg as AAC in an .m4a, so Arcfin can keep several audio tracks in a converted download (Jellyfin's conversion keeps only one). Client Settings: Download Quality now offers Arcfin's four download choices.

Added GET /ArcfinSync/Encoders: which video encoders (H.264, HEVC, AV1) work with the server's hardware acceleration setting, from a one-frame test encode per codec with the server's own ffmpeg and device. Kept until the encoding settings change; ?refresh=true tests again. Arcfin uses it to ask for AV1 only where the card can encode it.

Fixed the plugin targeting the wrong Jellyfin ABI (was 10.9.0.0/net8.0, now 12.1.0.0/net10.0), which caused a Malfunctioned status on real servers. Removed an unnecessary FrameworkReference the plugin loader rejects. Replaced the free-form Locked Settings table with a real Client Settings editor mirroring the app's own Settings hierarchy. seerrUsername is now derived from Seerr Account Type's lock state instead of being independently lockable. Switched dashboard tab navigation to Jellyfin's real multi-page mechanism.
